label: R7 · Your attacks
rationale: The opponent has no cards in hand and no untapped mana; their Helicarrier can't be crewed (crew 6; their creatures' total power is at most 3) and nothing of theirs flies, so Aerial Doombot is unblockable. Quake 3/3 can only be blocked by a 2/2, a 1/1 or a -3/1, and any block trades in your favour. Attack with both; not attacking gives away free damage.
